lessons.title: Counting 1 to 10
lessons.content: Let us learn counting numbers from 1 to 10. 1 (One Apple), 2 (Two Birds), 3 (Three Cats), 4 (Four Dogs), 5 (Five Stars), 6 (Six Flowers), 7 (Seven Bananas), 8 (Eight Balls), 9 (Nine Butterflies), 10 (Ten Pencils). Count items carefully by pointing to each one.

lessons.title: Numbers 11 to 20
lessons.content: Now let us count beyond 10! 11 is Ten and One. 12 is Ten and Two. 13 is Ten and Three. 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19, and 20 (Two Tens). Practice writing digits 11 through 20 in your notebook.

lessons.title: Basic Shapes
lessons.content: Shapes are all around us! A Circle is round like a wheel or a coin. A Square has four equal straight sides like a checkerboard. A Triangle has three corners and three sides. A Rectangle has four sides with opposite sides equal like a book cover.

lessons.title: Inside and Outside
lessons.content: Let us understand positions and space. 'Inside' means within a boundary, like toys inside a box. 'Outside' means out of the boundary, like birds outside a cage. Practice observing objects on top of, under, inside, and outside containers.
